name: Key Terms Schedule
description: A one-page schedule to a Fontara services agreement that states its key commercial terms — initial term, renewal, notice periods, late fee and price cap — each bound to Docusign's standard agreement field, so Agreement Manager reads them from the signed copy.

fontara_entity.label: Fontara contracting entity

Fontara, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 1500 Harbor Boulevard, Suite 1200, San Francisco, CA 94111
optionValues.Fontara UK Ltd: Fontara UK Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales with its registered office at 48 Ashcombe Street, London EC2A 4NE, United Kingdom
optionValues.Fontara Europe Ltd: Fontara Europe Ltd, a company registered in Ireland with its registered office at 3 Riverside Quay, Dublin 2, D02 X285, Ireland

fontara_entity.description: Prints the entity’s full legal description and address

price_cap.description: Most the price may rise per renewal, in percent

body.p: This schedule forms part of the services agreement between {{fontara_entity}} ("Fontara") and **{{customer}}** dated {{effective}}.

Initial term: {{term}}. The agreement then renews for successive periods of {{renewal_term}} unless either party gives notice at least {{renewal_notice}} before the end of the current period. The customer may extend the current period once by {{renewal_extension}}.
Either party may terminate for convenience on {{convenience_notice}} written notice, and for cause if a material breach is not cured within {{cause_notice}} of written notice.
Late payments bear a fee of {{late_fee}}% per month. On each renewal Fontara may raise its prices by at most {{price_cap}}%.
